retrievalProfile.description: A soft-focus 1980s glamour portrait featuring a subject on a scalloped shell-shaped sofa with a mix of elegant script and wide-tracked sans-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A warm, diffused studio portrait of a woman with voluminous dark hair, seated on a mauve scalloped sofa. The composition is balanced by a floral arrangement on the left and elegant, layered typography in the upper left quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered on a textured, shell-like sofa
Soft, warm lighting creating a hazy, romantic atmosphere
Typography anchored to the top left, overlapping the background
Color harmony between the mauve sofa and the subject's skin tones

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, occupying the middle and right thirds of the frame in a seated pose.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and voluminous hair serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the subject's face down to the hands, then left to the typography and floral element.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open space in the upper left corner provides a clean area for the title text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mauve and dusty rose (sofa and background)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep browns and blacks (hair and vase)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft whites and lavender (clothing and text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high key lighting, creating a dreamy, low-contrast feel.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to muted pastels and warm neutrals

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A combination of a formal, slanted script and a wide, geometric sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Script features high contrast and elegant flourishes
Sans-serif is all-caps with extreme horizontal tracking
Horizontal rules underline the script text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended swashes on capital letters in the script
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a decorative script with a minimalist, spaced-out sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Double horizontal lines underlining the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the formal, slanted script style with high contrast.
Appropriate for the wide-tracked, small-cap feel of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus 1980s studio portrait of a woman with voluminous hair sitting on a mauve scalloped shell-shaped sofa. Include a dark vase with flowers on a side table to the left. Use warm, diffused lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a formal script title in the upper left, underlined by two thin horizontal lines. Below the lines, add a subtitle in a wide-tracked, all-caps sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting soft and diffused?
Is the sofa texture clearly scalloped?
Is the typography placed in the upper left quadrant?
Does the subtitle have significant letter spacing?

mustRedesign: Do not use contemporary sans-serif fonts like Helvetica
postGenerationChecks: Verify the shell-like texture of the sofa
Ensure the typography is legible against the background
recipe.reuseFormula: Soft-focus portrait + Scalloped furniture + Script/Sans-serif typographic lockup
